decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the explicit user-fee insufficiency conclusion and requirement to demonstrate availability-payment necessity; the general projection statement does not independently change the sizing mechanics.
The projection statement does not change the existing requirement to annotate provisional assumptions or its reference basis, and it does not explicitly require a new traceability behavior.
The source clarifies the investment-case narrative and projected nature of figures but does not change the candidate's data-review, error-checking, or modeling-integrity standards.
The source does not modify the model's presentation-quality, understandability, or auditability requirements.
The source does not change the confirmed debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or streamlined financing structure.
The capex state already records that its figures are provisional, and the source does not change the capex estimate, basis, or shared-cost treatment.
The source does not revise the annual operating-cost range, its assumption basis, or the exclusion of the Appendix figure.
The projection and availability-payment narrative does not change the authoritative Business Case site list.
